ff01.title: Lower Back Pain When You Press? Fix This 🔥 #shorts
ff01.description:
FORM FIX #01 — Overhead Press

❌ Wrong: Leaning back turns it into an incline press.
✅ Right: Squeeze your glutes. Ribs down. Press straight up, in line with your ears.

Stacked = stronger and safer.

ff02.title: Why Your Side Delts Aren't Growing #shorts
ff02.description:
FORM FIX #02 — Lateral Raise

❌ Wrong: Swinging + shrugging = your traps do the lifting.
✅ Right: Lead with your elbows. Lift out, not up. Stop at shoulder height. Lower for 2–3 seconds.

Lighter weight. Wider shoulders.

ff03.title: Fix Rounded Shoulders With This One Exercise #shorts
ff03.description:
FORM FIX #03 — Face Pull

❌ Wrong: Pulling to your chest turns it into a row.
✅ Right: Rope at face height. Pull to your forehead. Elbows high and wide. Hands finish by your ears.

Do it every upper day. Your posture will thank you.

▶ Full Shoulder workout explained in 3D is on the channel.

ff04.title: Stop Rolling Your Shrugs (Do This Instead) #shorts
ff04.description:
FORM FIX #04 — Dumbbell Shrug

❌ Wrong: Rolling adds nothing. Traps only move up and down.
✅ Right: Straight up. Shoulders to your ears. Hold 1 second at the top. Lower slowly.

Simple. Heavy. Controlled.

🔔 Subscribe — a new FORM FIX every day.

ff05.title: Half Rep Pull-Ups Don't Count #shorts
ff05.description:
FORM FIX #05 — Pull-Up

❌ Wrong: Stopping halfway skips the best part of the rep.
✅ Right: Start from a dead hang. Arms fully straight. Pull until your chin clears the bar.

Can't do one yet? Use bands or slow negatives.

ff06.title: Your Bent-Over Rows Are Just Shrugs #shorts
ff06.description:
FORM FIX #06 — Bent-Over Row

❌ Wrong: Standing too upright turns rows into shrugs.
✅ Right: Hinge to about 45°. Flat back. Pull the bar to your belly button.

Hinge. Brace. Row.

ff07.title: Deadlift Mistake That Wrecks Your Lower Back #shorts
ff07.description:
FORM FIX #07 — Deadlift

❌ Wrong: Bar drifting forward loads your lower back.
✅ Right: Bar over midfoot. Shins almost touching it. Drag it up your legs. Push the floor away.

Close bar = stronger, safer pull.

🔔 Subscribe — a new FORM FIX every day.

ff08.title: Stop Bouncing the Bar on Bench Press #shorts
ff08.description:
FORM FIX #08 — Bench Press

❌ Wrong: Bouncing uses momentum, not your chest.
✅ Right: Lower for 2 seconds. Touch. Pause. Press. More time under tension = more muscle.

Slow down. Grow more.

ff09.title: Dumbbell Flys Hurting Your Shoulders? #shorts
ff09.description:
FORM FIX #09 — Dumbbell Fly

❌ Wrong: Straight arms dropping way below the bench.
✅ Right: Soft bend in your elbows, like hugging a tree. Stop when your hands reach chest level.

The stretch is the point. Not the depth.

🔔 Subscribe — a new FORM FIX every day.

ff10.title: Dips Hurting Your Shoulders? Fix Your Depth #shorts
ff10.description:
FORM FIX #10 — Dips

❌ Wrong: Sinking too deep, shoulders rolling forward.
✅ Right: Lean slightly forward. Chest up. Stop when your elbows hit 90°.

Control the depth. Keep the shoulders.

ff11.title: Your Bicep Curls Are Half Reps #shorts
ff11.description:
FORM FIX #11 — Barbell Curl

❌ Wrong: Stopping short at the bottom AND the top.
✅ Right: Arms fully straight at the bottom. Squeeze all the way up. Lower for 2–3 seconds.

Full range beats heavy weight.

ff12.title: Skull Crusher Mistake Most Lifters Make #shorts
ff12.description:
FORM FIX #12 — Skull Crusher

❌ Wrong: Flared elbows shift the load to your shoulders.
✅ Right: Elbows point at the ceiling. Upper arms stay still. Lower to your forehead. Only the forearms move.

Elbows in. Triceps on.

ff13.title: Why Your Tricep Kickbacks Do Nothing #shorts
ff13.description:
FORM FIX #13 — Triceps Kickback

❌ Wrong: Upper arm swinging = momentum, no tension.
✅ Right: Pin your upper arm parallel to your body. Only the forearm moves. Squeeze at the back.

Lock it in. Then kick.

ff14.title: Knees Caving In When You Squat? Fix It #shorts
ff14.description:
FORM FIX #14 — Squat

❌ Wrong: Knees collapsing inward stresses the joint.
✅ Right: Push your knees out over your toes. Feet flat. Grip the floor with your whole foot.

Knees track toes. Every rep.

ff15.title: Lunges Hurt Your Knees? Take a Longer Step #shorts
ff15.description:
FORM FIX #15 — Lunge

❌ Wrong: Short step, heel lifts, knee shoots forward.
✅ Right: Take a longer step. Front heel stays down. Drop the back knee straight down.

Long step. Strong legs.

ff16.title: Glutes Not Growing? Fix Your Hip Thrust #shorts
ff16.description:
FORM FIX #16 — Hip Thrust

❌ Wrong: Arching your lower back at the top.
✅ Right: Chin tucked. Ribs down. Shins vertical at the top. Squeeze for 1 second.

Hips up. Back neutral.

ff17.title: Your Plank Is Useless (Unless You Do This) #shorts
ff17.description:
FORM FIX #17 — Plank

❌ Wrong: Hips sagging dumps it all on your lower back.
✅ Right: Squeeze your glutes. Brace like a punch is coming. Head to heels, one straight line.

20 good seconds beat 2 bad minutes.

🔔 Subscribe — a new FORM FIX every day.

#formfix #gymtips #coreworkout #plank #fitness #shorts

ff18.title: Stop Pulling Your Neck on Crunches #shorts
ff18.description:
FORM FIX #18 — Crunch

❌ Wrong: Yanking your head up strains your neck.
✅ Right: Fingertips light. Elbows wide. Curl your ribs toward your hips. Exhale.

Short range. Real squeeze.

🔔 Subscribe — a new FORM FIX every day.

#formfix #gymtips #coreworkout #crunch #fitness #shorts

ff19.title: Stop Swinging on Hanging Leg Raises #shorts
ff19.description:
FORM FIX #19 — Hanging Leg Raise

❌ Wrong: Swinging = momentum. Your hip flexors do it all.
✅ Right: Dead still. No swing. Curl your pelvis up, knees toward your chest.

Slow up. Slower down.

🔔 Subscribe — a new FORM FIX every day.

ff20.title: Your Calves Have 2 Muscles — Train Both #shorts
ff20.description:
FORM FIX #20 — Calf Raise

❌ Wrong: Straight-leg raises hit the gastrocnemius.
✅ Right: Bent-knee raises shift work to the soleus. Seated calf raises do this even better.

Train both. Bigger calves.
